# Year 9 Residential Trip to York

20 April 2026

Dear Parents and Carers,

I am writing to give you the details of the Year 9 residential trip to York, which runs for three days in June. Please read this letter carefully and keep it for reference.

## Dates and Times

Departure: Wednesday 17 June 2026

Return: Monday 15 June 2026

Meeting time: 8:15 am at the main gate of the school

Departure time: 8:00 am by coach from the school

We expect to arrive back at the school at about 5:30 pm on Friday 19 June 2026.

Trip leader: Mr Daniel Whitefield (Head of Year 9)

## Cost

The trip costs £300 per student. This covers coach travel, two nights' accommodation with all meals, museum entry and a guided walking tour.

With 124 students taking part, the total cost of the trip is £38,200.

The cost is paid in two instalments:

| Instalment | Amount | Due by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1st payment | £170 | Friday 15 May 2026 |
| 2nd payment | £150 | Friday 26 June 2026 |

Payments are made through the school's online payment system. If you would like to discuss help with the cost, please contact the school office in confidence.

## What to Bring

Please pack the following six items:

- the trip booklet
- a packed lunch for the first day
- a waterproof coat
- comfortable walking shoes
- any regular medication, handed to staff at the coach
- a refillable water bottle
- pocket money (no more than £30)

## Questions

If you have any questions about the trip, please contact Mr Daniel Whitfield by email at trips@millbrook-school.example or by phone on 0113 496 0173.

Yours faithfully,

Mr Daniel Whitfield
Head of Year 9
Millbrook Academy
